verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime gives developers building blocks for background automation, not a native automation feature. Webhooks can be registered for event types such as `card.create`, and the Card Auth Loop endpoint lets your own business logic accept or reject card transactions at authorization time. Any autonomous behavior must run in infrastructure the user builds and hosts. Missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring transfers, a rules or automation engine, any hosted background-job capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
